title: Soft crest (in the plugin now)
note: Gaussian core with broken lace, a faint shoulder ahead and a streaky wake. Bobs 1 px.

title: Whitecap
note: Ragged breaking lip, foam behind it, spray specks thrown ahead.

title: Unbroken swell
note: A pale crest band with a darker trough behind it; no foam. Reads as deep water.

title: Hard pixel line
note: A 2 px white line with a 1 px blue shadow, stepped like DF's own pixel art.

title: ASCII tildes
note: Three sideways '~' per tile riding the front, the literal ASCII look.

title: Level '~' (in the plugin now)
note: Two white '~' per tile, bobbing and sliding. Placeholder.

title: Swash sheet
note: Thin water sheet running up the sand with a bright ragged lip.

title: Bubble clusters
note: Ring bubbles that grow, pop and re-form at random.

title: Lace over a wet film
note: World-anchored lace, seamless across tiles (the old `wash on` foam).

title: Breathing foam line
note: One continuous line along the edge that advances and retreats.

title: DF's own mist (reference)
note: Vanilla FLOW_WATER_MIST, density frames 1-4, as DF draws spray today.

title: Drifting puffs
note: Soft round puffs that drift inland, swell and thin out.

title: Dithered shade
note: An ordered 2x2 dither at the density level, faithful to ASCII ░▒.

title: Wind wisps
note: Thin streaks of blown spray moving with the wind.

title: Caustic web
note: Bright where two drifting noise fields meet, like sunlight on shallows.

title: Sun glints
note: Sparse single-pixel glints that twinkle frame to frame.

title: Wind ripples
note: Long, low ripple lines drifting downwind.
